title: Provisioning state machine w/ persisted transitions + audit trail
creator: Vanessa Ortiz
project: Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
description:
Implement the end-to-end provisioning state machine for Dedicated pool bring-up runs and persist transitions with an audit trail.

State machine
- Requested → Provisioning → Imaging → Bootstrapping → Validating → Ready
- Any non-terminal stage can transition → Failed
- (Optional for later) Paused is handled in ENG-2751; design here should not block adding it.

Why
- We currently have ambiguous “is it ready?” semantics across Infra/SRE/Platform handoffs.
- We need an authoritative control-plane record of what stage a pool is in, how long it’s been there, and why it failed.
- Routing integration depends on “Ready” being a reliable gate.

Requirements
1) Persisted state transitions
- A "ProvisioningRun" (or equivalent) record keyed by pool_id + run_id (UUID) with:
  - current_state
  - created_at/updated_at
  - initiated_by (actor)
  - trigger_source (api/cli/automation)
  - correlation_id (string) propagated into logs/metrics
  - last_error_code + last_error_message (human-readable)
- A "ProvisioningTransition" (append-only) table capturing:
  - from_state, to_state
  - timestamp
  - actor (service principal / user)
  - reason (e.g., "stage_success", "stage_failure", "manual_override")
  - metadata (stored as stringified JSON if needed; keep schema flexible)

2) Transition semantics
- Only allow valid transitions; reject invalid transitions with explicit error.
- Idempotency:
  - If a stage reports completion multiple times, we should not create duplicate transitions (best-effort de-dupe on (run_id, to_state) w/ monotonic checks).
  - If a run is already terminal (Ready/Failed), further updates should be rejected unless a new run is created.
- Concurrency:
  - Multiple workers may attempt updates; use optimistic concurrency / compare-and-swap on current_state.

3) Audit trail
- Audit trail must be queryable by operators:
  - show timeline of transitions for a run
  - show last N runs for a pool
- Must capture actor identity for manual triggers (CLI/API) and service principal for automated transitions.

4) Operator experience / API needs (used by ENG-2743, ENG-2750, Control Plane)
- API should support:
  - create run (Requested)
  - get run status (including current_state, stage timings)
  - list transitions

5) Metrics hooks
- Emit structured events on transition (stage_start/stage_finish/stage_failure) with correlation_id (ENG-2748).

Out of scope
- Pause/resume and partial re-run UX (ENG-2751 / ENG-2747 / ENG-2746). This ticket just makes sure the model can support those later.

Acceptance criteria
- [x] State machine with enforced valid transitions implemented in control plane backend.
- [x] Transitions persisted and append-only.
- [x] Run status endpoint returns current state + timestamps.
- [x] Audit view endpoint returns ordered transition history.
- [x] Unit/integration tests cover:
  - valid path to Ready
  - failure from each non-terminal stage
  - invalid transition rejection
  - duplicate transition idempotency
  - concurrent update behavior
- [x] Backward compatibility: existing pool registration flow remains functional; new fields are additive.

Implementation notes (proposed)
- Define enums: Requested, Provisioning, Imaging, Bootstrapping, Validating, Ready, Failed.
- Store last successful stage timestamp to support time-in-stage metrics without parsing logs.
- Error codes should be normalized strings (e.g., DNS_TLS_FAILED, GPU_HEALTH_FAILED, TF_APPLY_FAILED) with message for operator detail (aligned with ENG-2742 follow-on improvements in PR-48242).

Links
- Confluence overview: /eng-infra/gpu-fleet-and-capacity/provision-to-ready-automation-overview
- Related PR (expected): sources/github/redwood/pr-48231.json
comments: 2025-02-20 (Vanessa Ortiz): Marking P0 for sprint. We need the persisted state model before we can safely wire up Ready gating in routing. Please keep the initial schema minimal + additive; we can extend with pause/resume later.

2025-02-22 (Ethan Park): +1 on optimistic concurrency. We’ve been bitten by duplicate writes from retried jobs. Please ensure terminal states are immutable; a new provisioning attempt should create a new run_id rather than mutating an old run.

2025-02-24 (Rafael Mendes): From SRE perspective: make sure failure transitions capture a stable error_code. We’ll page/alert on stuck stages and failure rates; free-form messages are not enough for aggregation.

2025-02-26 (Gabe Wilson): Started implementation. Plan: add ProvisioningRun + ProvisioningTransition tables; expose internal service methods for transition() with allowed transition map. Will keep metadata as a single string column containing JSON for now to avoid schema churn.

2025-03-01 (Benji Okafor): For audit: please include actor_type (user/service) and actor_id. This will also matter once break-glass overrides exist for config validation. Even if we don’t ship break-glass here, bake the fields now so we’re not backfilling later.

2025-03-04 (Gabe Wilson): PR up: "Add provisioning state machine types and persistence layer changes" (PR-48231). Includes migration + tests for invalid transitions and CAS failures. Added error_code + error_message columns, plus correlation_id on run.

2025-03-06 (Ravi Menon): Routing side depends on Ready being authoritative. Please confirm that a run can’t reach Ready without passing Validating in the transition map (no direct Provisioning→Ready).
2025-03-07 (Gabe Wilson): Confirmed transition map is strict: Validating is required before Ready. Also ensured once Ready/Failed, further stage updates are rejected with explicit error.
2025-03-10 (Vanessa Ortiz): Reviewed PR-48231 and left minor nits. Main ask: add index for (pool_id, created_at desc) so the CLI can list last runs cheaply.
2025-03-12 (Gabe Wilson): PR-48231 merged with requested index + docs. Marking Done. Follow-ups tracked in ENG-2748 for event emission plumbing and ENG-2751 for pause/resume.
